inclusions.source: Pickup is from your hotel in Luxor, typically in the morning to allow for a reasonable afternoon arrival.
The drive is private, meaning the vehicle and driver are yours alone.
The vehicle is air-conditioned, which matters — the desert crossing can be very hot, particularly between April and October.

inclusions.text: Drop-off at your hotel or resort in Marsa Alam
